reserveStock: all-or-nothing reservation that checks product.canReserve for every line before calling product.reserve, and throws DomainError('insufficient_stock') (domain business rule)
productFor: looks up a product in an in-memory ReadonlyMap and throws DomainError('not_found'); no repository or I/O access
releaseStock: calls product.release on in-memory domain objects; no persistence or transport

parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file src/domain/stock-reservation.ts contains only domain logic. It sums order-line quantities per product and reserves stock all-or-nothing, checking every line before any stock moves. It also releases stock and raises DomainError when a product is missing or stock is too low. These are all business rules that work on in-memory domain objects (Product, OrderLine). There is no persistence such as repositories, SQL or ORM calls. There is no transport (HTTP, messaging or serialization) and no framework or orchestration logic like transactions, logging or use-case flow. Loading the products and saving changes is left to the application use cases that import this file. Every responsibility fits the domain layer.
